approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in HNK-LINGUAS after the exact AN / EN / KUVAN / KU / KE rebind proposal was presented.

decisions_requested.statement: Approve AUTH-016 AN as the exact governed form for L02 FIRST_PERSON_REFERENT by extending curriculum scope from lessons [L01] to [L01,L02], with authority remaining CANDIDATE and no historical recovery claim.

Approve AUTH-017 EN as the exact governed form for L02 SECOND_PERSON_REFERENT by extending curriculum scope from lessons [L01] to [L01,L02], while preserving unresolved subject/possessive behavior outside scoped constructions.
Approve AUTH-001 KUVAN as the exact governed form for L02 LOCATION_INTERROGATIVE by extending curriculum scope to L02 without making KU or VAN globally productive.
Approve AUTH-018 KU as the exact governed form for L02 CONTENT_SELECTOR by extending curriculum scope to L02 without assigning KU one universal WH gloss.
Approve AUTH-019 KE as the exact governed form for L02 QUESTION_OPERATOR by extending curriculum scope to L02 without creating universal HNK interrogative grammar.
Confirm that approval changes only the lesson-scope binding of these five existing authored candidates in @hnk/linguas; it creates zero new surface forms and zero new language assets.
Preserve VANI and VANUVALI unresolved in L02; do not use either form to satisfy any approved semantic target and do not generalize the L01 residence interpretation of VANI.

Keep L02 pedagogy authoring on HOLD after mapping approval. Form selection alone does not authorize OPI, Story, Q&A, Structure, Vocabulary, Activation or Review payloads; a separate pedagogy-source gate is required.
